photos.desc: Helicoprion was a eugeneodontid, a grouping of shark-like holocephalans that brandished large tooth whorls in their upper or lower jaws.
Helicoprion bessonovi - edestid "shark" from Early Permian (Artinskian) of Ural region. Highly hypothetical reconstruction.
Reconstruction of Helicoprion bessonovi from Early Permian of Middle Ural
Helicoprion reconstruction at the "Permian Monsters" special exhibit at the North Carolina Museum of Natural Sciences
A composite whorl of Parahelicoprion consisting of fragments collected between 1916-1926 in the Ural Mountains. Paper describing specimen was published in 1927
Isolated teeth of Parahelicoprion clerci, photographed and described by Alexander Karpinsky
